status: exploratory amendment, 2026-09-23; no new scientific results
primary: Unchanged v4 endpoint hierarchy, policy and paired bootstrap; new diagnostics are post-hoc.

stability.replay: One PLAN and one APPLY per panel step; 0.5 times their separate mean token CE, including canonical EOS; train-only balanced operation/field pool
stability.progress_rule: positive >=0.001 absolute mean correct-mass gain on fixed TRAIN probe OR full dev ordinary A; no B/D selection
stability.selection_rule: Explicit single recipe/step with full dev retention gate and nonzero composition progress; ties prefer fewer steps then lower replay cost; not a paper success gate
stability.full: initial, final, and explicitly selected intermediate step; all 125 depth3 candidates
stability.monitor: fixed dev atomic 20/op, dev ordinary 16/family, all dev B/D crossed, first 4 complete TRAIN panels; never final
stability.resume: checkpoint adapter + Adam + RNG Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA + exact next step and counters; independent restart is not resume
stability.compute: replay/no-replay is a diagnostic ablation, not equal compute

matched.rule: same selected steps/LR/replay/data/order/base; optional complete entropy factorial only after stability admission

confirmation: one selected pair, masks1/2, paired seeds0/1/2; immutable lock before final; no automatic confirmation from stability screening
provenance: verified / declared_only / unknown; missing history permits description, blocks never_seen_pairs, length_extrapolation and historical_recipe claims; Q2 requires verified task-training history and its unchanged numeric gate

q1_posthoc.reference: fixed first 64 ordinary dev A tasks from inherited v4 data, known fields only; post-hoc permitted A reference, no B/D or new fields
q1_posthoc.scope: additive model of program scores, no causal neural-module interpretation; normalize each row; per-task between/within pool identity; never replaces primary
